infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the "Aspect" company building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Aspect company office key (Aspect) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key from the entrance to the office of Aspect LLC on 56 Primorsky Ave.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: This key is not necessary to get into the building since it has a hole in the wall on the backside, but it provides an alternative entrance, helping player avoid Kaban guards on the NSV and AGS emplacements.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the "Aspect" company building at Streets of Tarkov.
